subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this be handled as a Trim OS package/version-skew diagnostic issue, or should OpenClaw add or change a supported local auth/pairing bypass or repair path for this deployment?
rationale: The observed 1002 path points at protocol mismatch, but the requested workaround touches device-auth and generated `gateway.auth` behavior; that is a Gateway security boundary and external packaging decision, not a safe autonomous bug fix without live trace evidence.

options.title: Require live Trim OS trace first
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the first connect frame metadata, and exact installed CLI/Gateway/package versions before changing auth behavior.

options.title: Add narrow diagnostics only
options.body: Improve `doctor` or logs to surface package version skew and config-regeneration ownership without weakening pairing or auth defaults.

options.title: Sponsor an auth behavior change
options.body: Define an explicit threat model and upgrade path for any loopback-only device-auth bypass or config override before implementation.

recommendation.title: Require live Trim OS trace first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the first connect frame metadata, and exact installed CLI/Gateway/package versions before changing auth behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision spans Gateway protocol docs, client package behavior, and release/package expectations, where this history is strongest among the identified owners.
